from pathlib import Path
import datetime,gzip,hashlib,json

p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
validation=json.loads((p/'validation-design-seal.json').read_text())
for file in validation['files']:assert hashlib.sha256((p/file['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==file['sha256'],file['path']
quality=json.loads((p/'preaggregate-quality-audit.json').read_text())
assert quality['passed']and quality['fights']==18144
strengthRaw=(p/'strength-registration.json').read_bytes()
strength=json.loads(strengthRaw)
assert hashlib.sha256(strengthRaw).hexdigest()==quality['registrationSha256']
assert not(p/'post-cold-registration.json').exists()
index={(r['board'],r['game']):r['arms']for r in json.loads(gzip.decompress((p/'complete-trace-index.json.gz').read_bytes()))}
selected=json.loads((p/'fresh-cold-cases.json').read_text())
assert len(selected)==36 and sum(r['originalHost']=='local'for r in selected)==18
jobs=[]
for row in selected:
 arms=index[(row['board'],row['game'])]
 assert set(arms)=={'stock','mixture','accepted'}
 assert all(a['inputSha256']==row['expectedInputSha256']for a in arms.values())
 jobs.append({**row,'stage':'fixed-fresh-cold','modes':['stock','mixture','accepted'],
  'expectedTraceSha256':{m:a['traceSha256']for m,a in arms.items()},
  'expectedScore':{m:a['score']for m,a in arms.items()}})
with(p/'post-cold-jobs.json').open('x')as f:f.write(json.dumps(jobs,separators=(',',':'))+'\n')
files=list(strength['files'])
for name in ['post-cold-jobs.json','prepare-post-cold.py','run-post-cold.py','verify-post-cold.py',
             'preaggregate-quality-audit.json','complete-trace-index.json.gz','validation-design-seal.json']:
 f=p/name
 assert not any(r['path']==name for r in files)
 files.append({'path':name,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
now=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
reg={'id':'barrel-forecast-mixture-v11-fixed-fresh-cold-v1','at':now.isoformat(),
 'strengthRegistrationSha256':hashlib.sha256(strengthRaw).hexdigest(),
 'absoluteDeadlineEpoch':now.timestamp()+2700,
 'absoluteDeadlineUtc':(now+datetime.timedelta(seconds=2700)).isoformat(),
 'cases':36,'arms':['stock','mixture','accepted'],'hosts':['local','puffalo'],
 'workersPerHost':4,'nice':19,'executions':216,'files':files,
 'protocol':'All36 cases were selected before strength collection, exactly18 from each original host. '
 'Replay allthree arms onBOTH hosts after complete18144fight quality audit and before any score aggregation. '
 'Require exact consumedinput, fullaction/eventtrace, score, winner andactualturns against original records. '
 'Ignore only realclock timing fields. No new strength samples, outcome-based selection, policy/model/source edits, '
 'retries or cutoff extension. This separate fixed45min validation phase does not extend the strength collection cutoff.'}
raw=(json.dumps(reg,indent=2)+'\n').encode()
with(p/'post-cold-registration.json').open('xb')as f:f.write(raw)
print(json.dumps({'registrationSha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'cases':36,'executions':216,'cutoff':reg['absoluteDeadlineUtc']}))

run-post-cold.py.source:
from pathlib import Path
import concurrent.futures,hashlib,json,os,queue,subprocess,sys,threading,time

p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
host=sys.argv[1]
assert host in ['local','puffalo']
raw=(p/'post-cold-registration.json').read_bytes()
reg=json.loads(raw);seal=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
for row in reg['files']:
 assert hashlib.sha256((p/row['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==row['sha256'],row['path']
assert subprocess.check_output(['bun','--version'],text=True).strip()=='1.4.4'
assert json.loads((p/'preaggregate-quality-audit.json').read_text())['passed']
jobs=json.loads((p/'post-cold-jobs.json').read_text());assert len(jobs)==36
out=p/f'post-cold-{host}';out.mkdir()
q=queue.Queue()
for job in jobs:q.put(job)
lock=threading.Lock();stop=threading.Event();procs=[];started=time.monotonic()
deadline=reg['absoluteDeadlineEpoch']
state={'complete':False,'host':host,'cases':0,'fights':0,'expectedFights':108,'errors':[],
       'controllerPid':os.getpid(),'registrationSha256':seal,'absoluteDeadlineEpoch':deadline}
def status():
 payload={**state,'elapsedSeconds':round(time.monotonic()-started,3),
          'liveWorkerPids':[x.pid for x in procs if x.poll()is None]}
 (out/'status.tmp').write_text(json.dumps(payload)+'\n');(out/'status.tmp').replace(out/'status.json')
def terminate(reason):
 stop.set()
 with lock:
  state['errors'].append(reason)
  for proc in procs:
   if proc.poll()is None:proc.terminate()
assert time.time()<deadline
timer=threading.Timer(deadline-time.time(),lambda:terminate('Fixed cold cutoff reached; no extension or retry'))
timer.daemon=True;timer.start()
def lane(index):
 folder=p/'candidate'
 with(out/f'worker-{index}.log').open('x')as log:
  proc=subprocess.Popen(['nice','-n','19','bun','--preload',str(folder/'alias.ts'),
   str(folder/'strength-actor.ts'),str(out/f'worker-{index}.jsonl.gz'),'candidate'],
   cwd=p,stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=log,text=True,bufsize=1,
   env={**os.environ,'HOC_A19_CONTEXT_POLICY':'on'})
  with lock:procs.append(proc)
  try:
   while not stop.is_set():
    assert time.time()<deadline
    try:job=q.get_nowait()
    except queue.Empty:break
    task={**job,'replicaHost':host}
    proc.stdin.write(json.dumps({'job':task,'registrationSha256':seal})+'\n');proc.stdin.flush()
    while True:
     line=proc.stdout.readline()
     if not line:raise RuntimeError(f'Cold worker{index} exited at{job["board"]}/{job["game"]}')
     try:ack=json.loads(line)
     except json.JSONDecodeError:log.write(line);continue
     if isinstance(ack,dict)and ack.get('verified'):break
     log.write(line)
    assert(ack['board'],ack['game'],ack['rows'])==(job['board'],job['game'],3)
    with lock:state['cases']+=1;state['fights']+=3
   proc.stdin.close();assert proc.wait()==0
  except BaseException as error:
   terminate(repr(error));raise
  finally:
   if proc.poll()is None:proc.terminate();proc.wait()
try:
 with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=reg['workersPerHost'])as pool:
  fs=[pool.submit(lane,i)for i in range(reg['workersPerHost'])]
  while not all(f.done()for f in fs):
   with lock:status()
   time.sleep(5)
  for f in fs:f.result()
 assert state['cases']==36 and state['fights']==108 and not state['errors'];state['complete']=True
finally:
 timer.cancel()
 with lock:status()

from pathlib import Path
import datetime,gzip,hashlib,json

p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
rawreg=(p/'post-cold-registration.json').read_bytes();reg=json.loads(rawreg);seal=hashlib.sha256(rawreg).hexdigest()
for f in reg['files']:assert hashlib.sha256((p/f['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==f['sha256'],f['path']
assert json.loads((p/'preaggregate-quality-audit.json').read_text())['passed']

assert len(jobs)==36
rawsha={};seen=set();count=0
for host in ['local','puffalo']:
 status=json.loads((p/f'post-cold-{host}/status.json').read_text())
 assert status['complete']and not status['errors']and not status['liveWorkerPids']and status['fights']==108
 for f in sorted((p/f'post-cold-{host}').glob('worker-*.jsonl.gz')):
  raw=f.read_bytes();rawsha[f.relative_to(p).as_posix()]=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()

   r=json.loads(line);key=(r['board'],r['game']);job=jobs[key];mode=r['mode'];expected=index[key][mode]
   tag=(host,key,mode);assert tag not in seen;seen.add(tag);count+=1

   turns=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(r['actualTurns'],separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()

   assert r['quality']['rejected']==0 and r['decisionMicros']
   for n in r['quality']['neural']:assert n['modelErrors']==n['missingStart']==0

   if mode=='mixture':assert r['mixtureRoots']>0

assert count==216 and len(seen)==216
expected={(host,key,mode)for host in ['local','puffalo']for key in jobs for mode in ['stock','mixture','accepted']}
assert seen==expected
result={'passed':True,'at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 'cases':36,'executions':216,'bothOriginalHostsCovered':True,
 'allInputFullActionEventTraceOutcomeAndActualTurnsExact':True,
 'zeroEngineModelOrTimingFailures':True,'aggregateScoresInspected':False,
 'newIndependentStrengthSamples':False,'registrationSha256':seal,'rawSha256':rawsha}
with(p/'fresh-cold-parity.json').open('x')as f:f.write(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')

for file in validation['files']:assert hashlib.sha256((p/file['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==file['sha256'],file['path']
variant=sys.argv[1]if len(sys.argv)>1 else'primary'
assert variant in ['primary','coverage']
stem='v11-cost'if variant=='primary'else'v11-coverage-cost'

assert json.loads((p/'fresh-cold-parity.json').read_text())['passed']

for host in ['local','puffalo']:
 for phase in ['confirmation','post-cold']:
  status=json.loads((p/f'{phase}-{host}/status.json').read_text())
  assert status['complete']and not status['errors']and not status['liveWorkerPids']
strengthRaw=(p/'strength-registration.json').read_bytes();strength=json.loads(strengthRaw)
index={(r['board'],r['game']):r['arms']for r in json.loads(gzip.decompress((p/'complete-trace-index.json.gz').read_bytes()))}

 jobs.append(job)

 for ordinal in range(4):
  for mode in ['stock','mixture','stock','both']:add(cases[ordinal],phase,mode,live,True,ordinal-4)

 for ordinal,row in enumerate(cases):

assert len(jobs)==executions

for implementation in ['baseline','candidate']:
 dest=p/implementation/'serial-cost-actor.ts'

             'preaggregate-quality-audit.json','fresh-cold-parity.json','complete-trace-index.json.gz','validation-design-seal.json']:
 assert not any(r['path']==name for r in files),name
 files.append({'path':name,'sha256':hashlib.sha256((p/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
if variant=='coverage':
 for name in ['coverage-cost-cases.json','coverage-cost-plan.json']:
  files.append({'path':name,'sha256':hashlib.sha256((p/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
now=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
reg={'id':'barrel-forecast-mixture-v11-fixed-serial-cost-v1'if variant=='primary'else'barrel-forecast-mixture-v11-balanced-coverage-cost-v1','at':now.isoformat(),
 'absoluteDeadlineEpoch':now.timestamp()+maxSeconds,'absoluteDeadlineUtc':(now+datetime.timedelta(seconds=maxSeconds)).isoformat(),
 'strengthRegistrationSha256':hashlib.sha256(strengthRaw).hexdigest(),'files':files,

'if variant=='primary'else'Supplemental216cases selected without outcome/timing inspection: all108style/map/own/opponentDoctrinecells, opposite physicalteams/bothdraftorders per family,54ofeachgameindex. Original72study/gates unchanged; no rescue of a failed phase. ')+

run-v11-cost.py.source:
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os,subprocess,sys,threading,time

p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
variant=sys.argv[1]if len(sys.argv)>1 else'primary'
assert variant in ['primary','coverage']
stem='v11-cost'if variant=='primary'else'v11-coverage-cost'
expected=464 if variant=='primary'else 1328
caseCount=72 if variant=='primary'else 216
raw=(p/f'{stem}-registration.json').read_bytes();reg=json.loads(raw);seal=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
assert reg['variant']==variant and reg['executions']==expected and reg['preselectedCases']==caseCount
for f in reg['files']:assert hashlib.sha256((p/f['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==f['sha256'],f['path']
assert json.loads((p/'fresh-cold-parity.json').read_text())['passed']
assert subprocess.check_output(['bun','--version'],text=True).strip()=='1.4.4'
out=p/stem;out.mkdir();jobs=json.loads((p/f'{stem}-jobs.json').read_text())
processes={};logs=[];controls={};started=time.monotonic()
state={'complete':False,'fights':0,'expectedFights':expected,'errors':[],'controllerPid':os.getpid(),
       'registrationSha256':seal,'absoluteDeadlineEpoch':reg['absoluteDeadlineEpoch']}
def status():
 payload={**state,'elapsedSeconds':round(time.monotonic()-started,3),
          'liveWorkerPids':[proc.pid for proc in processes.values()if proc.poll()is None]}
 (out/'status.tmp').write_text(json.dumps(payload)+'\n');(out/'status.tmp').replace(out/'status.json')
def expire():
 state['errors'].append('Fixed v11 serialcost cutoff reached; no retry/extension')
 for proc in processes.values():
  if proc.poll()is None:proc.terminate()
assert time.time()<reg['absoluteDeadlineEpoch']
timer=threading.Timer(reg['absoluteDeadlineEpoch']-time.time(),expire);timer.daemon=True;timer.start()
try:
 for implementation in ['baseline','candidate']:
  folder=p/implementation;log=(out/f'{implementation}.log').open('x');logs.append(log)
  processes[implementation]=subprocess.Popen(['nice','-n','19','bun','--preload',str(folder/'alias.ts'),
   str(folder/'serial-cost-actor.ts'),str(out/f'{implementation}.jsonl.gz'),implementation],
   cwd=p,stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=log,text=True,bufsize=1,
   env={**os.environ,'HOC_A19_CONTEXT_POLICY':'on'})
 for proc in processes.values():
  subprocess.run(['/usr/sbin/taskpolicy','-B','-p',str(proc.pid)],check=True)
  subprocess.run(['/usr/sbin/taskpolicy','-t','0','-l','0','-p',str(proc.pid)],check=True)
  assert subprocess.check_output(['ps','-p',str(proc.pid),'-o','ni='],text=True).strip()=='19'
 for job in jobs:
  assert time.time()<reg['absoluteDeadlineEpoch']and not state['errors']
  task=dict(job);key=(job['board'],job['game'],job['mode'])
  if job['mode']=='both':
   control=controls.get(key)
   if job['live']:assert control is not None
   if control:
    task.update({'expectedTraceSha256':control['traceSha256'],'expectedScore':control['score'],'expectedWinner':control['winner']})
  proc=processes[job['implementation']]
  state.update({'phase':job['phase'],'ordinal':job['ordinal'],'mode':job['mode'],'warmup':job['warmup']});status()
  proc.stdin.write(json.dumps({'job':task,'registrationSha256':seal})+'\n');proc.stdin.flush()
  while True:
   line=proc.stdout.readline()
   if not line:raise RuntimeError(f'Cost actor stopped atjob{job["jobId"]}')
   try:ack=json.loads(line)
   except json.JSONDecodeError:print(line,flush=True);continue
   if isinstance(ack,dict)and ack.get('verified'):break
   print(line,flush=True)
  assert(ack['jobId'],ack['mode'],ack['implementation'])==(job['jobId'],job['mode'],job['implementation'])
  assert ack['inputSha256']==job['expectedInputSha256']
  if task['expectedTraceSha256']:
   assert ack['traceSha256']==task['expectedTraceSha256']and ack['score']==task['expectedScore']and ack['winner']==task['expectedWinner']
  if job['mode']=='both'and key not in controls:
   assert not job['live']
   controls[key]={k:ack[k]for k in ['traceSha256','score','winner','inputSha256']}
  state['fights']+=1;status()
 for proc in processes.values():proc.stdin.close();assert proc.wait()==0
 assert state['fights']==expected and len(controls)==caseCount and not state['errors'];state['complete']=True
except BaseException as error:state['errors'].append(repr(error));raise
finally:
 timer.cancel()
 for proc in processes.values():
  if proc.poll()is None:proc.terminate();proc.wait()
 status()
 for log in logs:log.close()
with(out/'established-both-controls.json').open('x')as f:f.write(json.dumps([{'board':b,'game':g,**v}for(b,g,_),v in sorted(controls.items())],indent=2)+'\n')
with(out/'analysis.log').open('x')as log:
 subprocess.run(['python3','analyze-v11-cost.py',variant],cwd=p,check=True,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 subprocess.run(['bun','verify-v11-cost.ts',variant],cwd=p,check=True,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)

gateCombination: Require original independent strength+quality/cold gates and BOTH original72case and additional216case aggregatecost gates. No result rescues a failed phase. No automatic promotion.
